verdict: Organic visibility holds steady; overdue CRM and outreach blockers need resolution.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, every measurable action came from Google Business Profile — 398 total actions (7 calls, 282 direction requests, 109 website clicks) with zero paid spend running on any channel. Forte Precision Metals showed a strong 57% spike in GBP engagement week-over-week, though that momentum softened in the final three days of the period; Advance Grinding Services and O'Hare Precision Metals both saw week-over-week GBP declines of 16% and 21% respectively, with two O'Hare profiles generating zero calls despite meaningful impressions — a profile audit is underway. Several CRM and outreach milestones that were due in July and August remain open, which is holding back the full lead generation system from coming online. Resolving those blockers is the priority work this month, and outreach sequences and site re-indexing are targeted for completion by end of September and October.

watch_item.fix: A profile audit is in progress now to confirm and correct any broken contact information on both listings.
